from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib,json,re,shutil
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path.cwd()
PROD=Path.home()/'prediction_research_prod'
INTENDED=[
 'control/codex_supervisor/build_planner.py',
 'tests/control/test_build_planner_nonbuildable_components.py',
 'tests/control/test_build_planner_retry.py',
 'knowledge/codex_runtime/CONFIG.json',
]
DEMO='control/dev_checks/project_executor_demo_e001.py'
assert PROD.is_dir(),'PROD_MISSING'
for rel in ['control/codex_supervisor','tests/control','tests/codex_supervisor']:
 src=PROD/rel
 assert src.exists(),'LOCAL_BASE_MISSING:'+rel
 for p in src.rglob('*'):
  if not p.is_file() or '__pycache__' in p.parts or p.suffix in {'.pyc','.pyo'}: continue
  r=p.relative_to(PROD)
  if str(r)==DEMO: continue
  q=ROOT/r; q.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); shutil.copy2(p,q)
# CONFIG is copied as the local baseline, then exactly one build_planner pin value is changed.
src_cfg=PROD/INTENDED[3]; dst_cfg=ROOT/INTENDED[3]
assert src_cfg.is_file(),'LOCAL_CONFIG_MISSING'
dst_cfg.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); shutil.copy2(src_cfg,dst_cfg)
planner=ROOT/INTENDED[0]
assert planner.is_file(),'PLANNER_MISSING'
text=planner.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
for marker in [
 'For REQUIRES_SHARED_INFRA or INSUFFICIENT_SPEC, components MUST be an empty list []',
 'NONBUILDABLE_COMPONENTS_MUST_BE_EMPTY',
 'BUILD_PLANNER_RETRY_LIMIT_REACHED',
 'BUILD_PLANNER_COMPLETE_WITHOUT_STATE_ADVANCE',
]: assert marker in text,'PLANNER_MARKER_MISSING:'+marker
new_sha=hashlib.sha256(planner.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
raw=dst_cfg.read_text(encoding='utf-8'); obj=json.loads(raw)
hex64=re.compile(r'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'); hits=[]
def walk(v,path=()):
 if isinstance(v,dict):
  for k,x in v.items():
   ks=str(k)
   if isinstance(x,str) and hex64.fullmatch(x) and 'build_planner' in ks.lower(): hits.append((path+(ks,),x))
   if isinstance(x,(dict,list)): walk(x,path+(ks,))
 elif isinstance(v,list):
  for i,x in enumerate(v): walk(x,path+(str(i),))
walk(obj)
uniq=[]; seen=set()
for p,v in hits:
 if p not in seen: seen.add(p); uniq.append((p,v))
assert len(uniq)==1,'BUILD_PLANNER_PIN_COUNT:'+str(len(uniq))
_,old_sha=uniq[0]
assert old_sha!=new_sha,'PIN_ALREADY_CURRENT'
assert raw.count(old_sha)==1,'OLD_PIN_NOT_UNIQUE'
dst_cfg.write_text(raw.replace(old_sha,new_sha,1),encoding='utf-8')
assert hashlib.sha256(src_cfg.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=hashlib.sha256(dst_cfg.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'CONFIG_NOT_CHANGED'
print('SYNC_AND_PIN_PASS')
print('PLANNER_SHA256='+new_sha)

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
want={'control/codex_supervisor/build_planner.py','tests/control/test_build_planner_nonbuildable_components.py','tests/control/test_build_planner_retry.py','knowledge/codex_runtime/CONFIG.json'}
cp=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],cwd=root,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
assert cp.returncode==0,'CACHED_DIFF_FAILED'
got={x.strip() for x in cp.stdout.splitlines() if x.strip()}
assert got==want,'STAGED_SET_MISMATCH:'+repr(sorted(got))
print('STAGED_SET_EXACT')
